svg.text: Bank Account and Transaction Management System · Project 55 (DBMS PBL)
15 tables · 19 foreign keys · crow's-foot (IE) notation · source: sql/01_schema.sql
Subtypes TRANSFER, CHARGE and LOAN_REPAYMENT are disjoint specialisations of BANK_TRANSACTION (composite FK on transaction_id + transaction_type). Every FK is ON DELETE RESTRICT.
